tool_signatures.name: create_dfw_rule
tool_signatures.description: [WRITE] Create a firewall rule under an existing DFW security policy.

rule_id.description: Unique rule id within that policy.

action.description: ALLOW, DROP, REJECT or JUMP_TO_APPLICATION (default ALLOW); JUMP_TO_APPLICATION needs an Environment policy.

sources.description: Source group paths like ['/infra/domains/default/groups/web']; omit for any.

destinations.description: Destination group paths; omit for any.

scope.description: Applied-to group/segment paths; omit for the whole DFW.

target.description: Target name from config; default if omitted.
